mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, request_id, account_id, profile_user_id, session_id, recommend_request_id, status, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{requestId}, #{accountId}, #{profileUserId}, #{sessionId}, #{recommendRequestId}, #{status}, #{totalAmount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'WAITING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'TIMEOUT_CLOSED', closed_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'WAITING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELED', closed_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'WAITING_PAYMENT'
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, request_id, account_id, profile_user_id, session_id, recommend_request_id, status, total_amount, paid_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT order_id, request_id, account_id, profile_user_id, session_id, recommend_request_id, status, total_amount, paid_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
